text.tspan: Blue identifies the brand. Neutrals carry the interface; green and red communicate outcomes, not decoration.
Lead Developer / Product Manager - Marcin Kordyaczny
Blueprint Blue #2563EB marks identity, links and
actions. Ink #0B1220 and Text #374151 carry copy.
Light grey #F1F3F5 carries social bands with Ink text
and blue accents. Use #6B7280 for control
Use green #15803D on #F0FDF4 for success and red
Pair colour with a label or familiar symbol. The full
project shell applies these semantic tokens; dark
mode uses lighter text on dark fields. Do not reuse
pale background colours as body text or confuse
Use at least 4.5:1 for ordinary text and 3:1 for large
text and required control graphics. Ratios here
assume opaque sRGB colours. Recheck after
changing a background, opacity, image or state. A
pale border alone cannot define an input.
